query: SELECT cc.nome, SUM(lc.valor) as lancTotal FROM lancamento_custo lc JOIN conta_custo cc ON lc.contaCustoId = cc.id WHERE lc.periodoCustoId = 30002 GROUP BY cc.nome ORDER BY lancTotal DESC LIMIT 5;
